JNU dismisses professor over sexual harassment allegations

Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) has dismissed Professor Angomcha Bimol Akoijam following an inquiry by the university's Internal Committee (IC). He was accused of sexual harassment by at least 10 students. The Pioneer also identified him as a Congress MP.
